summary: Jeanne Bliss argues that modern organizations have become siloed, with marketing, operations, and sales excelling in their disciplines while customers move across the entire journey. She proposes placing a central function to orchestrate a holistic, one-company customer experience. The video highlights social media as a powerful revealer of the total customer experience, beyond traditional service metrics. Bliss teaches that insights should be drawn from the lives of customers and validated with numeric survey data, but the story should be led by the lived experience rather than by the score alone.
title: Using Social Media to Map the Total Customer Experience
topics: not letting scores drive the narrative
voice of the customer through social data
holistic customer experience vs departmental silos
